backup.production_rule: telegram_pending_kind_check re-created with the 17 production values (read from pg_constraint 2026-10-05) plus refund_confirm, inquiry_reply and lock_code; booking_lifecycle_events_event_type_check widened by guest_replied; three new service_role-only definer functions (telegram_inquiry_view_v1, telegram_inquiry_decide_v1, telegram_inquiry_message_logged_v1). No table, column, policy, grant-on-existing-object or data change; nothing is dropped. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup, then fill both. Take a fresh backup if the one named is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: pending_check_names_the_new_kinds_and_keeps_the_old
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%refund_confirm%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%inquiry_reply%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%lock_code%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%guest_save%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%llm_house%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%awaiting_reply%' from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.telegram_pending'::regclass and conname = 'telegram_pending_kind_check'

forward_verification.name: lifecycle_check_names_guest_replied_and_keeps_the_old
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%guest_replied%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%rate_promotion_ended%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%hold_created%' from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.booking_lifecycle_events'::regclass and conname = 'booking_lifecycle_events_event_type_check'

forward_verification.name: functions_service_role_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('service_role','public.telegram_inquiry_view_v1(uuid)','execute') and has_function_privilege('service_role','public.telegram_inquiry_decide_v1(bigint,uuid,text,text,integer,text)','execute') and has_function_privilege('service_role','public.telegram_inquiry_message_logged_v1(uuid,bigint,text,text,text,boolean,text,text)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.telegram_inquiry_view_v1(uuid)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.telegram_inquiry_view_v1(uuid)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.telegram_inquiry_decide_v1(bigint,uuid,text,text,integer,text)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.telegram_inquiry_decide_v1(bigint,uuid,text,text,integer,text)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.telegram_inquiry_message_logged_v1(uuid,bigint,text,text,text,boolean,text,text)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.telegram_inquiry_message_logged_v1(uuid,bigint,text,text,text,boolean,text,text)','execute')

forward_verification.name: definer_with_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 3 and bool_and(p.prosecdef and p.proconfig = array['search_path=""']) from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and p.proname in ('telegram_inquiry_view_v1','telegram_inquiry_decide_v1','telegram_inquiry_message_logged_v1')
